biotools.summary: VCF2PCACluster is a tool for principal component analysis (PCA) and clustering of SNPs from VCF formatted data. It is designed to be fast and memory-efficient, particularly for datasets with tens of millions of SNPs, and offers functionality for kinship estimation and visualization.
